planets.name: HD 80653 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 80653 with a 0.72-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 80653 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 80653. Its orbit and size follow Naponiello et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
